<subject>Team Meeting on 9th May</subject>
<body>
We will hold a team meeting on 9th May at 4 PM. The agenda includes loan portfolio reviews, credit policy updates, and team restructuring. Sandwiches and drinks will be provided. I plan to schedule these sessions monthly to keep pace with regulatory changes and ensure everyone is informed of updates across departments. If you can’t attend or want to suggest any topics, or have a sandwich preference, please inform me at your earliest convenience.

Thanks,  
Brandon
</body>
